name: User Stories for Allure Framework & Dark Factory Integration
desc: Бэклог пользовательских историй для интеграции фреймворка Allure Report и генерации отчетов BDD

cards.name: US_008.001 | Allure Reporting > Attach Dark Factory Execution Logs
cards.desc:
As a QA Automation Engineer,
I want the Dark Factory BDD runner to attach execution logs and JSON payloads to Allure reports,
So that I can quickly debug failed coordinate calculations and step execution errors.

cards.name: US_008.002 | Allure Reporting > Dynamic Gherkin Step Annotation
cards.desc:
As a Test Lead,
I want BDD scenarios generated from JSON user stories to dynamically render as Gherkin steps in Allure,
So that non-technical stakeholders can view readable Given-When-Then reports.

cards.name: US_008.003 | Allure Reporting > Auto-Generate HTML Dashboard Artifacts
cards.desc:
As a CI/CD Pipeline Engineer,
I want an automated process to compile ./allure-results into a static HTML report under ./allure-report,
So that test metrics and history are visible after every test suite run.
